verdict.line: You lose if you ever stand inside 535 range and eat the Apprehend pull into a full stack-up; you win if you poke from Q range and never give him a clean hook.

brief.thesis: Darius has no way to close the gap outside his E (Apprehend, range 535) — your Q (Parrrley, range 625) outranges every tool he owns except that one hook. This matchup is a range-discipline check: stay outside 535 and you dictate every trade with poison poke; drift inside it even once and his Hemorrhage stacks plus a level-6 Noxian Guillotine can end the fight in two abilities.

theirWindow.when: He lands Apprehend (E) and pulls you in
theirWindow.what: He will immediately auto and Decimate (Q) to stack Hemorrhage fast, then follow with Crippling Strike (W) to slow your retreat. Pop W (Remove Scurvy) to clear that slow and heal back out the moment you're free — you can't prevent the pull itself, only survive what comes after.

yourWindow.when: His E (Apprehend) is on cooldown — up to 26s at rank 1
yourWindow.what: Walk up to exactly 625 range and fire Q freely. He has zero gap-close without that hook, so every second it's down is a free poke window with no retaliation risk.

powerCurve.note: Q range poke, he has no answer yet
Decimate CD drops but still melee-range only
Guillotine online, stacked bleed kills fast

start.why: The extra AD and sustain let you keep auto-poking through his early Decimate swings without losing the trade war of attrition.

boots.why: Darius's damage is almost entirely physical autos and Decimate — the flat reduction blunts every stack-up attempt before he reaches Hemorrhage max stacks.

core.why: Mana sustain lets you spam Q (Parrrley) every 5s cooldown all lane without running dry, which is the entire win condition here.
Executes low-health targets after a poke exchange and adds the lethality that turns Q pokes into real kill threats.
Crit scaling converts your sustained Q poke into burst damage once he's forced to engage at a disadvantage.

situational.when: he starts stacking armor or health to shrug off your poke
his Decimate (Q) healing off your minions or jungle camps is keeping him topped up in trades
you need the lifesteal to win extended melee exchanges instead of pure poke

runes.keystoneWhy: The extra burn on ability hit stacks with your Q poke and passive poison, adding free damage to every trade without extending your exposure to Decimate.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 94% of games here — Ignite finishes poke trades before his Decimate heal can offset the damage, and Flash keeps you out of Apprehend range if he closes the gap unexpectedly.

playing.title: Hold the 625 range edge
playing.detail: Stand at max Q range and never step inside 535 unless his E is confirmed down. This single habit is the matchup.

playing.title: Count Hemorrhage stacks live
playing.detail: Disengage before he hits 5 stacks — that's when he enrages into massive bonus AD and his trades stop being even.

playing.title: Punish every E cooldown
playing.detail: The moment Apprehend goes on cooldown (up to 26s early), push forward and poke freely. He has no other gap closer.

playing.title: Respect level 6 onward
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine deals true damage scaled by your stack count — don't contest a trade above 2-3 stacks after he hits level 6.

playing.title: Save W for the post-pull slow
playing.detail: Remove Scurvy can't stop the Apprehend pull itself, but it clears the Crippling Strike slow that follows, letting your poison ticks finish the disengage.

playing.title: Watch for ult-reset snowball
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine refreshes its cooldown briefly on a kill — if he gets one, assume he can threaten again almost immediately.

playing.title: Farm through item spikes
playing.detail: Essence Reaver into Collector is where your poke starts actually threatening kills — play for that spike rather than forcing early all-ins.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, build paths, runes, and summoner picks above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.19.1) via OP.GG; the range-control reasoning and trade windows are my own read of the kit interactions.

stats.opponentTip: Do not get pulled by his (E). Focus on farming lane safely. Be careful when he uses Ghost.
